Section 1.0 — Architecture & Page Hierarchy

1. Platform Architecture & Master Page Inventory

The Turfify frontend is architected as a high-performance, dual-role sports ecosystem. It provides both consumer-facing match booking for active sports enthusiasts and an enterprise facility console for turf owners.

Core Architectural Principle: Zero Double-Booking & Instant UI Responsiveness
Every interactive button communicates through the unified TurfifyStore state machine. When a player books an hourly slot or an owner logs a cash walk-in, the slot is locked immediately across all views to prevent slot collisions.

1.1 Master Page Inventory

Page / Screen File Path Primary User Role Key Functional Purpose
Marketplace Home index.html Public / Player Hero banner, multi-parameter search bar, sport pills, verified turf listings, owner registration banner.
Player Hub Portal player-dashboard.html Registered Player Next match kickoff countdown, GPS directions, squad sharing, active bookings, match cancellation, loyalty coins.
Turf Owner ERP owner-dashboard.html Turf Facility Owner Today’s turnover, slot occupancy rate, 16-hour live slot matrix, manual walk-in blocker, add grounds modal, payouts.
Unified Portal dashboard.html Dual-Role Switcher Seamless toggle between Player View and Owner View without page reloading or loss of state.
About Platform about.html Public / Enterprise Company background, sports infrastructure mission, founder vision, investor metrics, and partner contact.

1.2 Modal Overlay Architecture

The frontend uses three non-destructive modal overlays that mount dynamically over any viewport:

Slot Booking Modal

Player

Pre-fills venue pricing, calendar date picker, morning/evening slot chips, dynamic price calculation, and instant reservation trigger.

Owner Facility Modal

Partner

Pitches onboarding form: venue name, sport type, ground dimensions, price per hour, and phone number for 2-hour onboarding dispatch.

Authentication Modal

Dual Role

Interactive role selection toggle (Player vs. Turf Owner) allowing dynamic redirect to either Player Hub or Partner Console.

1. Location Dropdown
#select-location		 Selects area from dropdown:
• Koramangala, HSR Layout, Indiranagar, Jayanagar, Whitefield, All. 		• Dropdown displays selected neighborhood.
• Mismatched cards fade out instantly.

2. Sport Selector
#select-sport		 Selects sport:
• Football, Cricket, Badminton, Basketball. 		• Active sport pill card highlights in pastel tint.

3. Date Selector
#select-date		 Selects date:
• Today, Tomorrow, Weekend, Calendar. 		• Updates search bar date label.
• Adjusts slot counters on cards ("12 slots left today").
• Passes date into the Booking Modal. 		• Queries TurfifyStore.getSlots(turfId, date).
• Excludes slots booked by players or blocked by owner.
4. Time Window
#select-time		 Selects hourly quadrant:
• Morning (6-10 AM), Day (10-4 PM), Evening (4-8 PM), Night (8-Midnight). 		• Shows venues operating during that window.
• Evening/Night prioritizes Floodlights.
• Day prioritizes Covered / AC venues. 		• Slot-level filter against facility operating hours.
• Sorts search results by highest availability.
5. Search Turfs Button
#btn-search-turfs		 Clicks teal gradient search pill button. • Button exhibits tactile press effect.
• Viewport smooth-scrolls to venue listings.
• Notification toast confirms matching venues. 		• Intercepts form submit via e.preventDefault().
• Compiles composite filter: Location + Sport + Date + Time.

Next Kickoff Hero Card 📍 Get Directions

Section 7.0 — Auth, Roles & Master Interaction Matrix

7. Dual-Role Auth Engine & Master Interaction Matrix

Turfify supports unified single-identity authentication where a user can operate as a player or switch into turf facility ownership.

⚽ Player Authentication

Consumer Flow

1. User clicks "Login" in navbar.
2. Selects radio button "⚽ Player Account".
3. Submits form → Authenticates via TurfifyStore.switchRole('player').
4. Toast confirms login and redirects to player-dashboard.html.

🏟️ Turf Owner Partner Flow

Enterprise Flow

1. User clicks "List Your Turf" or "Register".
2. Selects radio button "🏟️ Turf Owner".
3. Submits form → Authenticates via TurfifyStore.switchRole('owner').
4. Toast confirms login and redirects to owner-dashboard.html.
